onboarding.welcomeLead: Three short steps — and your child only watches what you approve on this tablet.
onboarding.step1Detail: On the dashboard — add a child profile.
onboarding.step2Detail: Search for a channel and approve it — only those appear for the child.
onboarding.step3Title: Protect parent controls with a PIN
onboarding.step3Detail: Set a 6-digit parent PIN. Only you can open the dashboard and settings on this device.
onboarding.pinHint: Next we will set your parent PIN (if needed), then go to the dashboard to add a profile and channels.

setupGuide.title: Quick start
setupGuide.subtitle: Two steps and your child is watching channels you approved.
setupGuide.completed: Initial setup is complete — safe viewing is ready.
setupGuide.stepProfileDetail: Each profile holds channels, limits, and kid-mode settings.
setupGuide.stepChannelsDetail: Only channels you approve will appear for the child — this is the watching step.

timeLimit.title: Daily watch limit
timeLimit.presetsHint: Pick a preset or enter a number of minutes
timeLimit.savedUnlimited: Time limit removed — unlimited daily viewing
timeLimit.invalidMinutes: Enter a number between 1 and 1440 minutes

shorts.hintOn: The child can also see short videos (up to 60 seconds and /shorts/).
shorts.hintOff: Short videos under 60 seconds and /shorts/ links are hidden from the child.

thumbnails.hiddenOn: Thumbnails hidden — black screen while playing
thumbnails.hintOn: List posters are hidden. The player stays black while audio/video continues in the background.
thumbnails.hintOff: Video posters and the player picture are shown normally.

manageProfile.title: {{name}}
manageProfile.lead: Approve channels and videos, and set Shorts, thumbnails, time limits, and device blocks for this profile.
manageProfile.channelsLead: Search and approve YouTube channels, or add individual videos to playlists.
